theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (V Y : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → InjOn ψ V → (∀ y ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ y)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → MeasurableSet Y → IsCompact (closure Y) → closure Y ⊆ V → (∀ y ∈ Y, G (ψ y) ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ∧ ∀ e, inner ℝ (G (ψ y)) (fderiv ℝ ψ y e) = fderiv ℝ F y e) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Y ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (Y ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}), g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in ψ '' Y, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, CountablyRectifiable n (ψ '' (Y ∩ F ⁻¹' {t})) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (ψ '' (Y ∩ F ⁻¹' {t}))), G x ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ y ∈ Y, ψ y = x → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (ψ '' (Y ∩ F ⁻¹' {t})) x (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) ⊓ (ℝ ∙ G x)ᗮ)
